description: The SmartAssist AI Platform is completely unavailable due to a failed database migration. Engineers are actively working on rollback.
The company VPN is operational but experiencing intermittent connectivity drops. Remote workers may face disconnections every 15-20 minutes.
The Employee Portal is partially unavailable. Login functionality is failing for users in the Hyderabad office due to an SSO issue.
The Internal Developer Portal is experiencing severe performance degradation. Page load times are 30-60 seconds due to a suspected memory leak.
The HR Management System is fully operational. The earlier report generation issue was resolved this morning.
The Finance System in Chennai is experiencing intermittent failures due to network packet loss on the Finance department network segment.
Company email is fully operational. No issues reported.
Jira is fully operational. No issues reported.
